data.narrative:
Greenroom Robotics is a Series A defense and security robotics company founded by Harry Hubbert, Zac Pullen, and James Keane. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 private companies and 2 public comparables operating in the Defense & Security sector. The three most directly comparable private peers—Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—all operate at the Series A stage.

The peer-median method, the sole applicable triangulation approach given available data, yields a valuation of $400M. This reflects the median valuation across the three same-sector, same-stage peers, which span a range of $125M to $4.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in company maturity and capital intensity within frontier defense tech at Series A. The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $340M (low) to $460M (high), with a midpoint of $400M.

Key uncertainties include the limited sample size for peer-median methodology (n=3), the substantial outlier valuation of Stark Defence relative to the other two comps, and lack of revenue or customer concentration data to assess Greenroom's relative positioning within this range. A more refined valuation would benefit from additional comparables, revenue multiples where available, and clarity on customer contracts or pipeline stage.
